meanings.usage: 表示对过去的行为感到后悔
常用于get a fright短语中
表示识别出某人或某物
指依法逮捕犯罪嫌疑人

phrases.usage: 表示过去习惯性的动作或状态，现在已不再发生

examples.en: Roy used to drive a taxi.

phrases.usage: 表示不久之前，相当于not long ago

examples.en: A short while ago, he became a bus driver.
examples.zh: 不久之前，他成了一名公交车司机。

phrases.usage: far用于加强比较级，表示更加、得多

examples.en: He is finding his new work far more exciting.
examples.zh: 他发现新工作更加令人兴奋。

examples.en: He saw two thieves rush out of a shop.
examples.zh: 他看见两个小偷从一家商店冲出来。

examples.en: The thieves ran towards a waiting car.
examples.zh: 小偷们朝一辆等候的汽车跑去。

examples.en: Roy acted quickly and drove the bus straight at the thieves.
examples.zh: Roy迅速行动，把公交车直接开向小偷。

examples.en: The one with the money got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
examples.zh: 拿着钱的小偷吓得把袋子都掉了。

examples.en: As the thieves were trying to get away in their car...
examples.zh: 当小偷们试图开车逃走时...

examples.en: Shortly afterwards, the police stopped the car.
examples.zh: 不久之后，警察拦住了那辆车。

grammar.title: used to + 动词原形
grammar.structure: 主语 + used to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 表示过去经常发生的动作或存在的状态，而现在已不再发生 用于描述过去的习惯或状态，与现在形成对比

examples.en: Roy used to drive a taxi.
He used to smoke, but now he doesn't.
examples.zh: 他以前抽烟，但现在不抽了。

grammar.title: such...that... 结果状语从句
grammar.structure: such + a/an + 形容词 + 可数名词单数 + that...
grammar.definition: such后面接名词，that引导结果状语从句，表示如此...以至于... 强调程度之高导致某种结果

examples.en: He got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
It was such a hot day that we went swimming.
examples.zh: 天气太热了，我们去游泳了。

grammar.title: While + 过去进行时
grammar.structure: While + 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing, 主语 + 动词过去式
grammar.definition: while引导的时间状语从句，表示两个动作同时进行 用于描述两个正在进行的动作同时发生

examples.en: While the battered car was moving away, Roy stopped his bus.
examples.zh: 当那辆破车开走时，Roy停下了公交车。

examples.en: While I was reading, she was cooking.
examples.zh: 我看书的时候，她在做饭。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + used to + 动词原形

original.en: Roy Trenton used to drive a taxi.

imitations.en: I used to live in Shanghai.
She used to play the piano.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + saw + 宾语 + 动词原形

original.en: He saw two thieves rush out of a shop.
original.zh: 他看见两个小偷从一家商店冲出来。

imitations.en: I saw him leave the room.
She saw the bird fly away.

patterns.pattern: such + a/an + 形容词 + 名词 + that...

original.en: The one with the money got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
original.zh: 拿着钱的小偷吓得把袋子都掉了。

imitations.en: He made such a mistake that everyone laughed.
imitations.zh: 他犯了如此可笑的错误，大家都笑了。

imitations.en: It was such a beautiful day that we went to the park.
imitations.zh: 天气太好了，我们去了公园。

original.en: Roy acted quickly and drove the bus straight at the thieves.
original.zh: Roy迅速行动，把公交车直接开向小偷。

imitations.en: The fireman acted quickly and saved the child.
imitations.zh: 消防员迅速行动，救了那个孩子。

imitations.en: She acted quickly when she saw the accident.
imitations.zh: 看到事故时她迅速采取了行动。

lines.en: Roy Trenton used to drive a taxi.
A short while ago, however, he became a bus driver and he has not regretted it.
lines.zh: 特雷顿原是开出租汽车的，然而就在前不久，他开上了公共汽车，也并不为此而感到后悔。

lines.en: He is finding his new work far more exciting.
lines.zh: 他发觉自己的新工作令人兴奋得多。

lines.en: When he was driving along Catford Street recently, he saw two thieves rush out of a shop and run towards a waiting car. One of them was carrying a bag full of money.
lines.zh: 最近，当他正开车在凯特福德街上行驶时，看到有两个小偷从一家商店里冲出来，奔向等在那里的一辆汽车，其中一个提着一只装满钞票的提包。

lines.en: Roy acted quickly and drove the bus straight at the thieves.
lines.zh: 罗伊行动迅速，开车直冲窃贼而去。

lines.en: The one with the money got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
lines.zh: 拿钱的那个小偷吓得把提包都扔了。

lines.en: As the thieves were trying to get away in their car, Roy drove his bus into the back of it.
lines.zh: 当那两个小偷企图乘车逃跑时，罗伊驾驶他的公共汽车撞在了那辆车的后尾上。

lines.en: While the battered car was moving away, Roy stopped his bus and telephoned the police.
lines.zh: 当那辆被撞坏的车开走后，罗伊停下车，给警察打了电话。

lines.en: The thieves' car was badly damaged and easy to recognize.
lines.zh: 小偷的车损坏严重，很容易辨认。

lines.en: Shortly afterwards, the police stopped the car and both men were arrested.
lines.zh: 没过多久，警察就截住了那辆车，两个小偷都被抓住了。

questions.q: How did Roy stop the thieves?
questions.zh: 罗伊是怎样拦住那两个小偷的？
questions.a: He acted quickly, drove the bus straight at the thieves and into the back of their car, then stopped and telephoned the police.
questions.aZh: 他行动迅速，把公交车直冲小偷开去并撞上他们车子的尾部，然后停车报警。

questions.q: Why has Roy not regretted becoming a bus driver?
questions.zh: 罗伊为什么并不后悔当上公共汽车司机？
questions.a: Because he is finding his new work far more exciting.
questions.aZh: 因为他发觉自己的新工作令人兴奋得多。

questions.q: What made the thief with the money drop the bag?
questions.zh: 拿钱的那个小偷为什么把提包扔了？
questions.a: He got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
questions.aZh: 他吓得如此厉害，以致把提包都扔了。
questions.hint: 见第 7 句 such a fright that。

questions.q: Why could the police recognize the thieves' car so easily?
questions.zh: 警察为什么能轻易认出小偷的汽车？
questions.a: Because Roy had driven his bus into the back of it and it was badly damaged.
questions.aZh: 因为罗伊的公交车撞上了它的尾部，车子损坏严重，很容易辨认。

questions.q: Do you think Roy was right to drive his bus at the thieves? Give your reason.
questions.zh: 你认为罗伊开车撞向小偷的做法妥当吗？说说你的理由。
questions.a: Yes. He acted quickly and used the bus to stop them, then let the police make the arrest; but it was risky and he might have called the police first.
questions.aZh: 妥当。他行动迅速，用公交车阻截并随后交给警察处理；但这也有风险，也可以先报警再跟踪。
questions.hint: 抓住 acted quickly、撞车后 telephoned the police。

translation:
罗伊。
特雷顿原是开出租汽车的，然而就在前不久，他开上了公共汽车，也并不为此而感到后悔。
他发觉自己的新工作令人兴奋得多。
最近，当他正开车在凯特福德街上行驶时，看到有两个小偷从一家商店里冲出来，奔向等在那里的一辆汽车，其中一个提着一只装满钞票的提包。
罗伊行动迅速，开车直冲窃贼而去。
拿钱的那个小偷吓得把提包都扔了。
当那两个小偷企图乘车逃跑时，罗伊驾驶他的公共汽车撞在了那辆车的后尾上。
当那辆被撞坏的车开走后，罗伊停下车，给警察打了电话。
小偷的车损坏严重，很容易辨认。
没过多久，警察就截住了那辆车，两个小偷都被抓住了。
title: Stop thief!
subtitle: 捉贼！

lead.question: 前出租车司机罗伊改开公共汽车后，凭什么让两个小偷几分钟内落网？
lead.warmup: 开出租车的人改开公共汽车，本是再普通不过的跳槽，却在某天变成一场追捕。罗伊握着方向盘，看见两个小偷从商店冲出来，其中一个提着鼓鼓的钱袋。他没有下车追赶，而是把几吨重的公交车当成了武器。几分钟后，警察拦下了那辆被撞得面目全非的小车。
goals: 听懂并复述课文，准确回答 How did Roy stop the thieves?
辨析 used to do（过去的习惯）与一般过去时的分工
掌握 far 修饰比较级，以及 such a … that 与 so … that 的互换
活用 rush、act、straight、fright、battered、shortly afterwards 讲这个故事
lead.summary: 课文讲前出租车司机罗伊改开公交车后，在凯特福德街上撞见两个抢钱的小偷：他开车直冲过去，撞瘪了对方的车尾，随后报警，警察很快截车抓人。语言上抓住三处：used to do 与一般过去时的分工；far 修饰比较级表强调；such a … that 与 so … that 引导结果状语从句。
lead.tips: such 后接名词（such a fright that…），so 后接形容词（so frightened that…），别写成 so a fright；used to 只表过去习惯，不能与 now 连用。

exercises.q: 用课文原词填空：A short while ago he became a bus driver and he has not ______ it.
exercises.note: while 作名词表“一段时间”。

exercises.q: 用 far 改写句子，加强语气：His new work is much more exciting.
exercises.a: His new work is far more exciting.
exercises.note: far/much 修饰比较级表强调。

exercises.q: 填空并说明时态差别：Roy ______ (drive) a taxi, but now he ______ (drive) a bus.
exercises.note: used to 表过去习惯，现已不再。

exercises.q: 把 such … that 改为 so … that：The thief got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
exercises.a: The thief was so frightened that he dropped the bag.
exercises.note: such 接名词，so 接形容词。

exercises.q: 按感知动词结构填空：He saw two thieves ______ (rush) out of a shop and run towards a waiting car.
exercises.note: see sb do sth 表看见动作全过程。

exercises.q: 中译英：罗伊行动迅速，开车直冲窃贼而去。
exercises.a: Roy acted quickly and drove the bus straight at the thieves.

exercises.q: 中译英：没过多久，警察截住了那辆被撞坏的车，它损坏严重。
exercises.a: Shortly afterwards, the police stopped the battered car. It was badly damaged.

quiz.q: 罗伊·特雷顿在改开公共汽车之前做什么工作？
options: He used to drive a taxi.
He used to drive a bus.
He used to work in a shop.
He used to be a policeman.
quiz.note: used to do 表过去习惯。

quiz.q: “far more exciting”中的 far 起什么作用？
options: 表示距离很远
表示时间很长
表示转折语气
修饰比较级，意为“……得多”

quiz.q: 拿钱的那个小偷为什么把提包扔了？
options: The bag was too heavy to carry.
The police told him to drop it.
He got such a fright that he dropped it.
His friend took the bag away from him.

quiz.q: 警察为什么能很快认出小偷的汽车？
options: It was a new taxi.
It was badly damaged and easy to recognize.
It was parked outside the shop.
It was carrying a bag full of money.

quiz.q: 下面哪一句正确表达了“他吓得把提包扔了”？
options: He got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
He got so fright that he dropped the bag.
He got such fright that he dropped the bag.
He got so a fright that he dropped the bag.

quiz.q: 课文中 “Shortly afterwards” 的意思最接近哪一项？
options: A long time later
At the same time
Before that happened
A short time later
quiz.note: shortly afterwards 意为不久之后。
